description: This file defines classes and protocols for simulating and retrieving network stream counters from a device called Xena. It includes data structures for counters, a protocol interface, and a simulated implementation generating deterministic pseudo-random data.

classes.name: StreamCounters
classes.description: Immutable data class representing raw counters for a single network stream.

classes.name: DeviceCountersSnapshot
classes.description: Immutable data class representing a snapshot of counters from a device, including timestamp and list of stream counters.

classes.name: XenaClient
classes.description: Protocol interface for fetching counters from Xena device.

classes.name: SimulatedXenaClient
classes.description: Class providing a deterministic, pseudo-random simulation of network counters, including logic to simulate dropped polls and errors.

methods.name: fetch_counters
methods.description: Method in both XenaClient protocol and SimulatedXenaClient class to retrieve current counters snapshot.

methods.name: _ensure_streams
methods.description: Internal method to initialize stream counters lists to ensure they have at least n elements.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for SimulatedXenaClient, initializes random seed and counters.
